contract.population: Adults aged at least 18 with recorded F/M in the selected Turkana 2018-2019 study-protocol context; actual demographic and lifestyle mixture unknown

law.independent_primitives: Across rows, independent draws of F~Bernoulli(p), G~Gamma(shape=k, scale=theta), and Z~MVN(0,R). F, G, and the vector Z are mutually independent. R is built from the three declared conditional rank parameters.
law.age: A=18+G; A_c=A-(18+k*theta). No finite upper-age bound, rounding, rejection, or outlier filter.
law.bmi: For sex s, vB_s=log(1+(sdB_s/mB_s)^2); B=exp(log(mB_s)-vB_s/2+sqrt(vB_s)*Z_B). Thus source-inspired arithmetic means and SDs hold within modeled sex, and age-BMI independence conditional on sex is explicit.
law.lipid_sex_term: For lipid j, delta_j=log(GM_F_j/GM_M_j). This preserves the numerical sex ratio of the selected Greiner geometric means under the declared common age and residual-shape assumptions, not their absolute levels.
law.mgfs: LA(t)=-k*theta*t-k*log(1-theta*t), for t<1/theta; LF(t)=log(1-p+p*exp(t)). These are log moment-generating functions of A_c and F.
law.lipid_variance_decomposition: v_j=log(1+(sd_j/m_j)^2)-[LA(2*b_j)-2*LA(b_j)]-[LF(2*delta_j)-2*LF(delta_j)]. Values are positive under the submitted parameters. The normal term includes BMI-linked plus remaining individual variation; it is not equated to a reported residual SD.
law.lipids: mu_j=log(m_j)-LA(b_j)-LF(delta_j)-v_j/2; L_j=exp(mu_j+b_j*A_c+delta_j*F+sqrt(v_j)*Z_j). This ensures whole-law arithmetic mean m_j and SD sd_j by moment algebra. Conditional on age and sex the positive variables follow a Gaussian copula with lognormal margins.
law.no_deterministic_lipid_identity: TC and HDL are separately generated directly measured values. No TC>=HDL restriction, non-HDL subtraction constraint, or post-generation reconciliation is imposed.
law.schema_support: A>=18, B>0 and each lipid>0 almost surely. Continuous variation remains in all three latent variables because R is positive definite. Unique deterministic string IDs are not participant identifiers.
law.tails: BMI and conditional lipids are lognormal, unbounded above with finite moments; age is shifted gamma with exponential tail. Lipid unconditional second moments exist because 2*b_j*theta<1. Lipid positive moments exist for order q<1/(b_j*theta), namely q<33.333333... for TC and q<200 for HDL; larger moments do not exist under this unbounded gamma-age/exponential-lipid law. No clinical extreme-value calibration, censoring model, or arbitrary physiological cap is claimed.
law.measurement: Generate measured concentrations as one observational distribution; measurement error is included implicitly in its individual spread. There is no identified separate biological/assay-error decomposition or validated bridge from fasting serum laboratory methods to immediate venous-EDTA CardioChek Plus measurement.
law.uncertainty: Parameters are fixed construction assumptions, not posterior draws. Repeated seeds vary fictional individuals only. Estimation uncertainty, shape uncertainty, and population/measurement transport uncertainty are not quantified.

assumptions.claim: p(F)=0.5, no modeled site/lifestyle strata, independent rows and equal analysis weights are a developmental composition scenario. They do not describe a known target mixture or sampling design.
Source women/men map to recorded F/M for numerical transport; target biological label legend is not independently established.

Shifted Gamma(2,10 years) represents a broad adult age distribution with mean 38 and no upper limit. Greiner rural median/IQR values are qualitative context only; their quantile conventions are unknown and this distribution was not fitted to them.

Age and BMI are independent conditional on sex. This is a deliberate simplifying assumption for missing joint covariate evidence, not a reported null relationship. Age is also independent of recorded sex.

Adopt Agongo sex-specific BMI arithmetic moments and pooled lipid arithmetic moments as whole-law adult scenario anchors. Age 40-60 Ghana, selection, ethnicity, assay and fasting differences prevent interpreting this as Turkana moment estimation or as reconstruction of Agongo's full source population.

Use lognormal BMI and age/sex-conditional lognormal lipids. Means and SDs identify their chosen normal log parameters only under this assumed family; the source does not establish the family or its tail shape.

TC log-age slope 0.003/year and HDL 0.0005/year are modest monotone age trends chosen as assumptions; neither is a published estimate. Nonlinear raw-scale effects mean the OLS age slope is a projection, not this log coefficient.

Use rural Malawi sex-specific geometric-mean ratios as conditional multiplicative sex effects with equal age distributions and common lipid log variance. Marginal sex contrasts can reflect age, BMI, health selection and other factors; this conditional interpretation and Ghana/Malawi combination are unverified transfer assumptions.

Use the rural Ashanti marginal unadjusted Spearman numbers as an explicit assumed within-age/sex Gaussian-copula rank scenario. Their transfer from marginal to conditional relations and from Ghana to the target is unverified. The Gaussian transform is a model-dependent mathematical identity, not conversion of a reported Spearman estimate into adjusted Pearson residual correlation. Urban values are an unexecuted alternative, not an averaged independent replication.

Treat admitted mmol/L concentration scales as usable scenario anchors without claiming assay equivalence. Unknown fasting, health selection, CardioChek error, and target exclusions are not invented or reconstructed.

analysis_definitions.eligibility: All generated rows must meet the task; no extra exclusions. Both models and residual correlation use the same full row set.
analysis_definitions.estimator: Unweighted OLS with M reference. BMI5 coefficient is the requested mg/dL per 5 kg/m^2 contrast.

goals.quantity: Pearson correlation of the two full-model residual vectors from the same rows/design

diagnostics.age_bmi_tc_hdl: Arithmetic mean, sample SD with ddof=1, q10/q50/q90 using NumPy linear quantiles; lipids converted to mg/dL first. The quantile convention is an explicit synthetic diagnostic convention, not an assertion of any source convention.
diagnostics.conditional_rms: sqrt(mean(residual**2)), denominator n, for each full OLS model in mg/dL; distinguish this from sqrt(SSE/(n-4)).
diagnostics.additional: F fraction; duplicate/missing/nonfinite/invalid row counts; exact ordered columns; full-design rank; BMI residual variance after intercept/age/F; within-sex counts and support; min/max and tail inspection; residual nonzero variances; TC-HDL scatter and absence of a deterministic identity.
diagnostics.execution_status: No generated-row diagnostics or finite-table analyses performed; root owns isolated execution. The retained exact calculations concern the probability law only.

law_level_computation.scope: Deterministic moment/OLS projection calculations; not source-population replay, simulation, or target validation

permitted_use: Fictional developmental tests of the requested analyses and transparent model-assumption exploration. No patient recovery, causal interpretation, clinical prediction, validated target inference, power calculation, assay equivalence, measurement savings, or publication-ready evidence claim.
